decision: Initiate, watch/defer, or do not initiate a long position in NVIDIA (NVDA) common stock, for a buy-side investment committee that holds no current position.
intended_user: Buy-side investment committee; no current NVDA position
horizon: 3-5 year holding period; five-year explicit forecast FY2027E-FY2031E plus terminal value
currency_and_units: USD; money in USD millions, per-share values in USD
share_basis: diluted: 24,514M FY2026 diluted weighted-average shares (10-K EPS note)
sources: Market data: NVDA $221.30, AMD $570.82, AVGO $346.25, 10y UST 5.190%, Yahoo Finance via yfinance, close 2026-10-14
Peers: AMD 10-K acc. 0000002488-26-000018; Broadcom 10-K acc. 0001730168-25-000121 (SEC XBRL company facts)

recommendation.reason: price $221.30 above DCF value $78.83, but NVDA trades below every admitted peer on EV/EBITDA and the earnings behind that multiple persist in this scenario
conditions: Watch holds only while NVDA's trailing EV/EBITDA stays below every admitted peer's and the evidence keeps EBITDA growing.
Initiate condition: price at or below the base-case DCF value.

Downside evidence that flips the action: a reported quarter showing year-over-year revenue decline or gross margin below 70% moves the evidence toward the AI-capex-digestion case, where the rule gives DO NOT INITIATE.

reversal_trigger: INITIATE if NVDA closes at or below the base-case value per share. DO NOT INITIATE if a 10-Q shows year-over-year revenue decline (the low-case path), or if NVDA's trailing EV/EBITDA rises to or above the lowest admitted peer's. Review at each 10-Q; next due for Q3 FY2027 (quarter ending late October 2026).

checks.check: Base revenue equals filed FY2026 revenue
Cash flow ties to balance-sheet cash
FCFF reconciles to the pro-forma's FCFE
Every company carries every field of the one definition
Peer fiscal years end within 120 days of NVIDIA's
Positive EBITDA and EPS for every admitted company
EV/EBITDA recomputes from its parts for every company
DCF grid monotonic (value falls with WACC, rises with g)

limitations: The forecast opens on the FY2026 (Jan 2026) balance sheet and discounts from that date; the price is October 2026. Debt rose to 33,366 and distributions continued in between.
WACC rests almost entirely on beta; the raw-to-Blume swing is about 200bp.
Two peers only; trailing multiples lag NVIDIA's growth.
Scenario endpoints are judgments, not probabilities.
